message.content:
The first risk is that supply constraints will limit the conversion of demand into revenue [D3]. That risk would be confirmed by management stating that the supply environment is less flexible today than a year ago or describing supply as a governor of near-term revenue conversion in subsequent earnings calls [D3].

The second risk is that one-time tariff impacts recorded in fiscal year 2026 will not repeat, creating a high comparison bar for future profitability [D4]. That risk would be confirmed by operating margin falling below the long-term target range of 31% to 32% in the fourth quarter or subsequent periods [D3].

The third risk is that the supply environment remains less flexible than a year ago, acting as a governor on near-term revenue conversion [D4]. That risk would be confirmed by management stating that supply chain will remain the governor of near-term revenue for the next several quarters in future guidance updates [D4].
